# UES Copy-Forward Checker (ues-checker.duess.com)

> Free, zero-upload, 100% browser-side Unified Export Strategy (UES) copy-forward checker built for USDA FAS cooperators and USAEDC members by Duess Strategies Inc.

## What It Does

- Compares this year's UES draft (`.docx`, `.pdf`, `.txt`, `.md`, or pasted text) against last year's submission locally inside the browser tab using deterministic JavaScript.
- Computes a Copy-Forward % score and flags verbatim recycled sentences, light find-and-replace edits, leftover stale years (`2024`, `FY25`), unchanged numbers, and paragraphs missing fresh results language.
- Zero uploads, zero AI APIs, zero server storage of UES drafts.
